notes.title: The Thrill of Auctions and Hidden Treasures
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]

Today, we’re diving into one of the most exciting aspects of Barn Finders—the auction mechanic and the intriguing variety of storage units you can discover.

[h2]Auction Mechanics: How It Works[/h2]
In Barn Finders, auctions are where the real action begins. You’ll compete against other bidders to win abandoned storage units that could hold untold treasures... or just a bunch of junk! The thrill of the auction lies in the mystery—you can only see a portion of what’s inside before making your bid. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/97349e4990274dfae9d0613382a3bd2f39ba75d9.gif[/img]
[h2]Unique Storage Units: From Pirate Treasures to Mysterious Spaces[/h2]
But what makes these auctions even more exciting are the unique and themed storage units you’ll come across. Imagine walking into a storage unit filled with pirate-themed decor—could there be an ancient chest filled with gold?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/78c89cd1f145a92e6f5f4f9e6c8fa5dd9c58dfeb.gif[/img]
Or perhaps you find yourself staring at what seems to be an empty unit, with just a few dusty boxes and an old ladder. Don’t be fooled; even the most unassuming spaces can hold the rarest items! Each unit is a gamble, and that’s what makes every auction a heart-pounding experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/e9da6cb2353ee2ca14cd5a59277c1b13dbb34e6e.gif[/img]
[h2]Have You Checked Out the New SuperHero Map?[/h2]
Speaking of exciting new content, have you explored the new SuperHero Map yet? It’s a free addition packed with new adventures and items to discover. If you haven’t checked it out, now’s the perfect time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/8be9de2d9465e8f3e84473a82dfea1450d3c0d92.png[/img]

[b]We know you love free game samples, so we've got something special for you! If you haven't checked it out yet, don't miss the Car Dealer Simulator Prologue. It's a great way to get a taste of what's to come in the full game. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

[u]Happy gaming, and stay tuned for more updates![/u]

notes.title: BarnFinders: Bid Wars DLC - devlog #4
notes.notes:
Homley

Uncle Billy used to say -  East, West, moonshine’s best.  We created a Homely zone inspired by these words of wisdom.
So if you wish to take a breather on M.I.K.K.O Island and relax between bids, you can discover hidden stories of the supporting characters of Barn Finders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/1d42180df6024ee160c7ff2e99e2e3f561ed7a8a.png[/img]

Dwayne was head over heels in love with Shirley. She was surprised most of the time. It’s a story of two lovebirds and their love nest in the hidden corners of Red Barn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/ca8d345538570cef39902e91f6ff7085e3d30dce.png[/img]

Where did Aunty Marry go missing? What did the homemade fertilizer do to her favorite plants? It’s kind of another love story and if you don’t believe, just ask Sebastian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/6235358ef8e408a070eca7866f0201ebae1492fa.png[/img]

Knuckle’s had a head(knack) for business. He rented his barn for an old fashioned polish wedding experience. And when the elite have fun, costs don't matter. You will find a  reconstruction of this epic event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/8bb9d56d0352d5aa86b9cd3ec2134c376419d210.png[/img]


And, as a bonus, some M.I.K.K.O “Nostalgia-bonanza”. Our love goes to all the Boomers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/be9aed607508a8481a9127d8ce002e246cc43f69.png[/img]

Duality Team
